BKT and Pirelli have today signed a strategic offtake agreement for production in India of 
Pirelli-branded premium car tires. This partnership combines the technological and innovation 
prowess of Pirelli, along with the industrial capabilities of BKT, to create a strong foundation to 
serve one of the fastest-moving and growing auto markets of the globe. 
 
In the first phase of this agreement, which is the offtake agreement, BKT will produce in its 
newly-constructed PCR plant at Bhuj, equipped with the most modern and advanced technology, 
Pirelli-branded tires with Pirelli-specific technology and quality standards. 
 
We expect the offtake from this partnership to commence in 2027. And this will scale up to 
supply 800,000 Pirelli-branded tires per year by the year of 2030.  
The agreement paves the way for the second phase in which there is an envisagement, at certain 
conditions, the creation of a 50-50 joint venture and the construction of a production plant 
dedicated to high-value passenger car tires, both with the Pirelli brand, as well as the BKT brand, 
to serve India and other international markets. 
India is a fast-growing passenger car market, which is growing at 6% to 7% annually. The 
premium car market is expected to grow at a faster pace in India over the next few years. For
